frames.datum_D: Named fixed feature at neutral propulsion centreline intersection with upper reference plane of fixed leg-attachment ring
frames.gimbal_rotation_body: R_BM = Rx(alpha) Ry(beta); alpha about body x, beta about carried y
frames.gimbal_rotation_cad: For a neutral FLU module frame: R_CM = Rx(alpha) Ry(-beta)
frames.joint_position_rule: r_Di = r_DOx + Rx(alpha) d_OxOy + R_BM r_Oyi,M, with all vectors expressed in their declared frames
frames.mass_conversion: Uniform material mass kg = solid.Volume_mm3 * density_kg_m3 * 1e-9
frames.inertia_conversion: Uniform material centroidal inertia kg m^2 = solid.MatrixOfInertia_mm5 * density_kg_m3 * 1e-15; rotate tensors and shift reference points separately
frames.scoring: Fixed D does not follow instantaneous complete-vehicle CG or gimbal articulation

landing_gear.feet: Separate finite contact solids and retention; material and dimensions remain study parameters

accounting_requirements.unknown_rows: Retain null sourced mass/cost. Separate any assumed scenario allowance from a supported ledger total; never silently use zero.
accounting_requirements.supported_complete_installed_mass: Must remain null while required mass rows or inclusions are unresolved
accounting_requirements.purchase_policy: Whole minimum packs and stock lengths, one required two-battery pack, no assumed owned items; ground equipment separate; PETG printed-part cost exempt but mass included
accounting_requirements.cutting_policy: Use actual finished member lengths and insertion geometry; share stock only for identical purchased material/section; charge unused offcuts

gimbal_domain.definition: Independent joint limits, not a 15-degree resultant cone
gimbal_domain.status: Exploratory domain; hardware travel not selected

clearance_study.allowance_status: Exploratory debits, not qualified tolerance or deformation bounds and not human-approved acceptance thresholds
clearance_study.ground_method: Place actual foot contact geometry against level ground at each body attitude; evaluate each rotor in the same pose. Treat compression and terrain assumptions explicitly rather than subtracting an unexplained global allowance.
clearance_study.sample_result_policy: Store minimum distance, nearest points, colliding pair, pose and common volume; zero distance alone does not quantify penetration
clearance_study.continuous_bound_policy: Report a bound only when supported by an implemented geometric/kinematic argument covering the declared domain; otherwise continuous result is null
clearance_study.acceptance_policy: Positive sampled separation is not continuous clearance or physical qualification

structural_and_contact_study.first_contact: Apply the complete selected scenario reaction to one foot in separate cases; do not divide by leg count
structural_and_contact_study.all_contact: Compute reactions only with explicit contact/compliance assumptions; four-foot sharing is not statically determined by geometry alone
structural_and_contact_study.limitations: Demand and ideal-member calculations do not establish printed-joint strength, laminate allowables, contact stiffness, stopping distance or physical landing safety
